values.note: THE LAUNCH PRESS's rehearsal on a validator of this machine (poleis/ceremony/the-launch-press-rehearsal.sh): the numbers are the rehearsal's, the ones THE TWO PROGRAMS IN ONE WORLD runs on (the estate's genesis, the market's law and bar), never his; every STAND-IN is an address (his posiverse's agents, its chairs; the floor's permit issuer; the door's miner; the board's crediter; the dollar; the board's judge is the swarm, root 0's own hand, derived) the rehearsal's stand-ins were made at on the local chain (their own process, their seed in the script's memory), filled from --stand-ins. THE WHOLE TREE DECIDES: root 0's floor is the minted Lyssajudrons, six stand-in people each minting one seat on the curve inside its window by the issuer's permit; no key of his is a param. pool.note: THE POOL IS BORN AT THE LAUNCH (his "Yes, add it", Nov 22 2026 01:18:14 UTC): the SPL stake pool born by root 0's raw act, act 5. Its list holds 10 validators, as devnet's did; its seeds are the tag and one letter (the pool p, its list l, its reserve r, its mint m), their base the deployer. No program hash is named: a rehearsal records the stake pool program's bytes where it first reads them, and its chain has the program only under LAUNCH_POOL_FROM_MAINNET=1 (a read of mainnet that waits for his word).

seal.note: THE LAUNCH NAMES THE SEAL'S ROAD: the rehearsal's road names its own validator (the sitting's --rpc, on this machine; seal.rpc is mainnet's word) and unit 1 of the sitting's own Poleis, the branch that runs the house (THE BRANCH VOTES ITS OWN CODE, his Nov 23 2026 "Yes, fix it"). ANY MEMBER PROPOSES, THE SWARM DECIDES (his Nov 23 2026 17:52 UTC "the swarm votes on updates, you dont have it linear with me and keystones", and his "Yes, build it" to "Take your key and your press out of the update road?"): the road names nobody who may propose; agent 1 and agent 2, two of unit 1's agents, each propose a release, the agents seal both in unit 1 with no seat holder asked, and the lane's lander ships by both seals, the second with no commit named (the newest the swarm sealed); a seal.proposers line is refused.
